nameEn: Leasing of intellectual property and similar products, except copyrighted works
description: This class includes the activities of establishing the right to use intellectual property assets such as patents, trademarks, brand names, and franchise agreements.
includes: granting of licenses for the right to use patented technology
payment of royalties and licensing fees
excludes: acquiring and selling of rights, see 7490
copyright buying and selling, see 5911 to 5920
